description: LunarWing OpenCode Worker — WebSocket agent communication protocol

task_request.description: Agent → Worker: submit a coding task

payload.context: object — optional TaskContext. conversation_history contains bounded user/assistant messages used only as untrusted JSON reference context; metadata, environment, and user_id are never added to model prompts. cron_tick.event = cron.tick enables creation of a relative project_dir under WORKSPACE_ROOT; creation is descriptor-relative and never creates through a symlink component (the returned path is re-resolved and confined to the root); ordinary tasks do not create directories
payload.timeout_ms: integer — hard deadline for the task (default 3600000)

cancel.description: Agent → Worker: cancel an in-flight task

task_prompt.description: Agent → Worker: follow-up prompt/directive for a RUNNING task (WI#328 runtime control channel; consumed by this worker — queued follow-ups are injected into the same opencode session at the turn boundary, never mid-call). A done=true prompt is injected with an appended wrap-up instruction and closes the queue: no further prompts are accepted for the task. The final task_result output accumulates every turn's assistant text, so a short follow-up never replaces the main deliverable

payload.seq: integer — monotonic per job, for ordering and dedupe
payload.prompt: string — TEXT directive only; validated daemon-side (16 KiB cap, no NUL bytes)
payload.done: boolean — true signals 'no more prompts coming, wrap up cleanly'

task_result.description: Worker → Agent: final result after completion

payload.error: string | null — error message if status=error

ready.description: Worker → Agent: sent once on connect to signal readiness

payload.capabilities: array of string — optional capability advertisement (WI#328); this worker advertises 'task_prompt' and consumes runtime control prompts

task_prompt_ack.description: Worker → Agent: receipt for a delivered task_prompt (WI#328). Sent only by workers that advertise the task_prompt capability; accepted=false means the task was already finished, the queue was closed (final drain done or a done prompt consumed), or the payload was invalid

error_codes.4001: Unauthorized — invalid or missing auth token
error_codes.4002: Task not found — cancel referencing unknown task_id
error_codes.4004: Rate limited — too many concurrent tasks
